findings.claim: The run report labels a selected-but-unattempted row and a never-selected eligible row identically as "not_run", so the report artifact alone does not distinguish a budget/deadline-skipped selected row from a row that was never in the selection; the distinction survives only in the separate manifest.selectedRowIds.
findings.reproduction: Run `npm run test:router-development-collector` and read tests/routerDevelopmentCollector.test.mjs, test "permanent reservations stop a selected population explicitly and completed rows never rerun": the manifest selects 2 rows with maxCalls=1, one row is dispatched, the run stops with `budget_stopped`, and the assertion `report.rows.filter((row) => row.outcome === "not_run").length === 359` holds — that 359 is the one skipped selected row plus the 358 never-selected eligible rows under a single label. Adding `selectedRowIds` (or a per-row `selected` flag) to collectionReport would separate them without changing any journal or manifest binding.
